chapter: Philadelphia and the McRae Brothers Band, 1908-1929
title: Savoy Ballroom contest against Fess Williams
summary: Invited to the Savoy to play against Fess Williams, the band surprised the audience, who had not known it was Black; the bassist played a pedal-type bass.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: brass. And people thought that this was a band from out West, you know. And when we went to the Savoy, we played -- They invited us to the Savoy one Sunday to paly against Fess William. And everybody was astonished to find out that this band was a colored band and had been in town for about a month playing over at a radio station, and they never had seen a picture or anything, you know. And Fess Williams himself didn't know how good this band was. He was up there with his clarinet. You know, you ever see Fess Williams' clarinet with all the rhinestones and things in it -- the hat with the rhinestones. He was just jumping up and down and his band was just playing. And we came out and we set up on the other bandstand. And when we hit -- I never could see the expression on his face, because he never expected a band like that. We had this fellow, a real tall fellow (inaudible)

play the bass horn. At that time, he played like, pedaling bass -- had a thing that rolled. It wasn't the type of bass that you had the Four (inaudible) things that you had to push down. They had a thing like the pedal. Like it was rolling.
His notes came out like an organ. When the band would be playing something, he'd just be rolling -- the bass would be just be rolling just like an organ, you know -- bass like that.
And they never heard anything like that. And we'd go in these fast things, you know.
What was his name? Do you recall?
Do you recall some of the other band members in the McRae Brothers Band?
No. I'd have to get them for you later on. I'm really going to look that up and find out who was in that band.
I have to call my brother on the coast and find out for you who played, because he's in California now. Out in Oakland, California.
